changes.label: R5 CAD study identification
changes.old: * Fingerworker MVP - R4 switch-fit drawing-based prototype; load rating unverified.
changes.new:
* Fingerworker MVP - R5 reach-fit CAD STUDY; load rating unverified.
 * R5: dynamic rest and end grip5 mm closer; full30-preload user travel.
 * Carriage absolute offset q=5+u; retained86 mm ISO sleeves use q=15-p
 * and user-relative approach u=10-p. ISO grip position is unchanged.
 * New guided P11 cam shoe is manually set to camTrim-preload.
 * Added pretension, return bosses and print joints need physical checks.
 * This local source is not a validated or strength-qualified release.
